data.title: Every AI model has the same “controversial” take on humans
data.description: We asked 12 AI models for their most controversial opinion of humans, three times each. 29 of 35 answers were the same one: we care more about belonging than about the truth.
data.keywords: what AI thinks of humans,AI controversial opinion,AI caricature of humans,ChatGPT vs Claude vs Gemini opinions,AI image models
